final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT t.observstation AS observstation, o.weathprofile AS weather, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avgband, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY t.observstation, o.weathprofile), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.weather AS weather, s1.avgband AS avgband, s1.cnt AS a, CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total AS ratio FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s2.total IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT weather, AVG(avgband) AS g_band, AVG(a) AS g_cnt, AVG(ratio) AS g_ratio FROM step3 GROUP BY weather) SELECT AVG(g_band), AVG(g_cnt), AVG(g_ratio) FROM step4
